nodes.label: Oculus Browser Remote HTML Injection and Code Execution (5.2.7 - 5.7.11)
nodes.precondition: Attacker lures victim using Oculus Browser (versions 5.2.7 through 5.7.11) to visit a malicious remote web page.
nodes.postcondition: Attacker injects arbitrary HTML into the Oculus Browser UI, spoofs UI elements, and gains local unprivileged code execution within the user's session.

nodes.label: Oculus Desktop OVRRedir.exe Hardlink Arbitrary File Write Privilege Escalation (< 1.44.0.32849)
nodes.precondition: Attacker possesses local unprivileged code execution on a Windows host running Oculus Desktop before version 1.44.0.32849.
nodes.postcondition: Attacker creates a hard link pointing an unprivileged log file to a critical target file, causing the privileged OVRRedir.exe process to write to arbitrary files and elevating privileges to SYSTEM.

nodes.label: Oculus Desktop OVRServiceLauncher.exe Handle Exposure Privilege Escalation (1.39 - 31.1.0.67.507)
nodes.precondition: Attacker has local unprivileged code execution on a Windows host running Oculus Desktop (versions > 1.39 and < 31.1.0.67.507).
nodes.postcondition: Privileged process handle is leaked to the attacker's unprivileged process, permitting local privilege escalation to high-integrity/SYSTEM.

nodes.label: Full Host Compromise via Oculus Windows Privilege Escalation
nodes.precondition: Attacker obtains local privilege escalation via OVRRedir.exe arbitrary file write or OVRServiceLauncher.exe handle exposure.
nodes.postcondition: Full administrative/SYSTEM access to the host operating system with complete control over data, processes, and configurations.

nodes.label: Raspberry Pi OS Default Credentials Exploitation (<= 5.10)
nodes.precondition: Raspberry Pi running Raspberry Pi OS through version 5.10 is accessible over the network or console with unmodified default credentials ('pi':'raspberry').
nodes.postcondition: Attacker gains authenticated shell and administrator/sudo access on the Raspberry Pi system.

nodes.label: piSignage Player API Path Traversal Arbitrary File Download (< 2.6.4)
nodes.precondition: Attacker holds low-privilege authenticated user access to piSignage web application prior to version 2.6.4.
nodes.postcondition: Attacker downloads arbitrary sensitive files (including system configs, shadow files, and service credentials) from the underlying Raspberry Pi via api/settings/log?file=../.

nodes.label: RaspAP 2.5 Web Console Remote Command Execution (includes/webconsole.php)
nodes.precondition: Attacker possesses valid authenticated web access to RaspAP 2.5 (e.g., via default credentials or credentials extracted from arbitrary file download).
nodes.postcondition: Attacker uses the misconfigured, unrestricted web console to execute arbitrary OS commands, upload malicious files, and execute code on the Raspberry Pi.

nodes.label: Raspberry Pi OS Command and Audio Hardware Control
nodes.precondition: Attacker attains OS command execution or administrator access on the Raspberry Pi via RaspAP web console or default credentials.
nodes.postcondition: Attacker controls processes, drives audio output through connected peripheral equipment, and alters power consumption states.

nodes.label: Raspberry Pi Power LED Glowworm Optical Acoustic Eavesdropping
nodes.precondition: Raspberry Pi 3 B+ or 4 B (through 2021-08-09) supplies power to audio-output speakers playing speech, and attacker has optical line-of-sight to the power indicator LED using a telescope and electro-optical sensor.
nodes.postcondition: Attacker recovers sensitive speech and sound signals played through the speakers by measuring and analyzing optical fluctuations corresponding to power consumption.

nodes.label: NVIDIA Jetson Linux IOMMU Misconfiguration DMA Exploitation
nodes.precondition: Unprivileged attacker possesses physical access to an NVIDIA Jetson board running vulnerable Jetson Linux and interfaces directly with the PCI bus.
nodes.postcondition: Attacker bypasses IOMMU restrictions to obtain direct read/write Direct Memory Access (DMA) to the entire system address space.

nodes.label: NVIDIA Jetson Total System Takeover and Scope Extension
nodes.precondition: Attacker achieves direct read/write access across the entire system address space via PCI bus DMA.
nodes.postcondition: Attacker achieves complete denial of service, arbitrary kernel/system code execution, privilege escalation to highest execution levels, and cross-component integrity/confidentiality breach.
